name: Flesh
description: Earth Affinity: You have resistance to earth dmg.

system.description: In a violent burst, multiple claw-bearing arms grow out of your body granting you the flurry of claws ability.
system.effect:
On cast: 
Roll the IP costs and pay it, and gain the Flurry of Claws Action.
When your HP runs out, turn into a 20-armed entity that attacks any creature that steps into range.
This creature can be killed and has 10 HP.
After the duration, lose Flurry of Claws Action and regain 10 HP (and regain old form).

Flurry of Claws (1 Attack Action without weaponbonus):
Attack your target in melee and deal 1d4 * (number of arms) dmg

system.description: The user is able to regrow body parts and attach them onto others. Limbs that are in itself self-sufficient and therefore have their own will. Little is known on how they have this intelligence. Most suspect it is more of an instinct imbued than a actual intelligence. These body parts die easily when not kept alive by the caster's will.
system.effect:
On cast: Choose one body part down below (each has a different utility)
End of affected ally turn: The part rots away (stays intact, when save succeeded).
- · 3 turns
Extra arms:
Parry +2
OR
Gives advantage on ally attacks
- · 3 turns
Extra eye:
Weaponattack +2
Caster Save Wil+2 · 2 turns
Puss bubble:
On enemy hit: Attacker takes 3d6 + (lvl * 1) earth dmg and Puss bubble is destroyed.
Caster Save Wil+2: 
On Success: Puss bubble restores.
- · 2 turns
Pulsating ulcer: 
2 less damage taken on every instance 
After 2 turns affected ally: 
Turns into chaotic fleshball that is controlled by the caster
Bonus Action when consuming Fleshball
3m (1,5m radius) · Ground Circle
- · 1 turn
Chaotic Fleshball (only from Pulsating ulcer): 
Explode and deal 3d6 + (lvl * 1) earth dmg 
OR
 Be consumed by the caster to heal 2d6 + (lvl * 1) hp

system.description: The user softens its on tissue, making sure that any kind of damage is kept at a minimum. Softened tissue has increased flexibility and bounces off physical attacks.
system.effect:
On cast: 
Gains resistance to all physical dmg (blunt, piercing, slashing)
